title: Mussels in Indian Spices Paella
description: A flavorful and aromatic paella dish featuring mussels in a blend of Indian spices.
instructions: Heat the luxurious oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the mussels, garam masala, cumin, turmeric, salt, and cayenne pepper.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the mussels start to open.
Add the paella rice and stir to combine.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the paella hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
